name: Boy Toy dance-pop years
source: en.wikipedia Like a Prayer (Kenneth G. Bielen): 'Five years earlier, [Madonna] was a dance-pop Boy-Toy'; Madonna (1983) 'consist[s] entirely of dance tracks'

name: Like a Prayer turning point
source: en.wikipedia (Entertainment Weekly, Nicholas Fonseca): an 'official turning point' in her career; Rolling Stone (J.D. Considine): 'far and away the most self-consciously serious album she's made'

name: I'm Breathless big band
source: en.wikipedia Madonna: 'Her other stylistic departures include 1930s big-band jazz on I'm Breathless (1990)'

name: Erotica
source: style; owner (Oct 2026): Erotica is a world of its own; Albumism puts the break between Erotica and Bedtime Stories

name: Bedtime Stories R&B turn
source: Albumism: Bedtime Stories 'the genesis of this second career epoch'; en.wikipedia: 'Madonna decided to tone these themes down for Bedtime Stories'

name: Evita
source: en.wikipedia Madonna: stylistic departures include 'operatic show tunes on Evita (1996)'

name: Electronic period with Orbit and Mirwais
source: en.wikipedia Music: 'seen as a continuation of the electronic-oriented work that was present on Ray of Light'; NME on American Life: 'an unnecessary sequel to ... Ray of Light and Music'

name: Confessions dance floor
source: en.wikipedia: 'It took the opposite direction from her previous studio album American Life'; Stuart Price songs that sounded like 'ABBA on drugs'

name: Hard Candy urban turn
source: en.wikipedia (MTV): 'moving in an urban direction'; BBC (Mark Savage): 'an attempt to capture the urban market'

name: Rebel Heart
source: en.wikipedia: 'a pop record that merges genres such as' 1990s house, trap and reggae; MuuMuse (Bradley Stern): an 'eclectic record'

name: Madame X / Lisbon period
source: en.wikipedia: 'a musical and lyrical departure from Madonna's previous releases'; Madonna on Lisbon: 'a melting pot of culture'

name: Confessions dance floor
source: en.wikipedia: 'Conceived as a sequel to Confessions on a Dance Floor (2005)' with Stuart Price
